description: Source-backed evergreen booster for query experiments. This enriches high-value Jharkhand entities without replacing live refresh.

entities.name: Jharkhand
entities.description: Jharkhand is a state in eastern India, formed on 15 November 2000, with Ranchi as its capital.

entities.name: Rugra
entities.description: Rugra is an indigenous seasonal food of Jharkhand that becomes abundant in local markets during the monsoon.

entities.name: Dhuska
entities.description: Dhuska is a traditional Jharkhand snack made from a rice-and-dal mixture and deep fried.

entities.name: Daal Pitha
entities.description: Daal Pitha is a Jharkhand dish of rice-covered dumplings with a spiced lentil filling.

entities.name: Chilka Roti
entities.description: Chilka Roti is prepared with rice flour and besan and is commonly made for festive seasons and special occasions.

entities.name: Sarhul
entities.description: Sarhul is a major spring festival of tribal communities in Jharkhand centered on worship of the Sal tree and nature.

entities.name: Karam
entities.description: Karam is a tribal festival associated with Karam Devta, youth, community celebration and agriculture.

entities.name: Tusu Parab
entities.description: Tusu is a winter harvest festival especially associated with the Bundu, Tamar and Raidih belt of Jharkhand.

entities.name: Sohrai
entities.description: Sohrai is an agricultural festival in Jharkhand associated with the care and celebration of domestic cattle.

entities.name: Chhau Dance
entities.description: Chhau is a well-known dance tradition of Jharkhand; the Seraikela school blends stylized movement with folklore, nature and mythology.

entities.name: Dassam Falls
entities.description: Dassam Falls is near Taimara village on the Ranchi-Tata road, about 34 km from Ranchi.

entities.name: Hundru Falls
entities.description: Hundru Falls is a major waterfall near Ranchi on the Subarnarekha River, about 45 km from the city.

entities.name: Jonha Falls
entities.description: Jonha Falls, also known as Gautamdhara, is about 45 km from Ranchi on the Ranchi-Purulia route.

entities.name: Patratu Dam
entities.description: Patratu Dam is west of Ramgarh and stores water from the Nalkarni river and surrounding hill streams.

entities.name: Baidyanath Dham
entities.description: Baidyanath Dham in Deoghar is a major Shiva pilgrimage site and one of the twelve Jyotirlingas.

entities.name: Trikut Pahar
entities.description: Trikut Pahar is a tourist destination in Deoghar known for hill scenery and adventure activities.

entities.name: Rajmahal
entities.description: Rajmahal is a historically important town on the right bank of the Ganges in Sahibganj district.

entities.name: Fossil Park Sahibganj
entities.description: A fossil park in the Rajmahal hills area of Sahibganj, where ancient plant fossils are found.

entities.name: Moti Jharna
entities.description: Moti Jharna is a waterfall attraction in Sahibganj district.
